description: Official pharmacy price, NFZ refund limit, refund level and patient co-payment of a medicine on the Polish refund list, with cheaper equivalents (same substance, strength and pack size) and the cheapest price per tablet. Also tells if the pack is free for seniors 65+, children under 18 or pregnant women. query: brand + strength ("Tulip 20 mg"), substance ("atorwastatyna 20 mg" / "atorvastatinum"), pack size ("30 szt") or EAN/GTIN.

indication.description: Disease or indication, when refund depends on it (e.g. 'cukrzyca')

query.description: Drug name / substance with optional strength and pack size, or EAN/GTIN

name: drug_price
title: Refunded drug price, co-payment and cheaper substitutes (Poland)
